text: Elena: Quick design follow-up from today's review — the in-product docs panel mixes 'Help', 'Docs', and 'Guides' across the header, breadcrumb and footer CTA. Users hit support asking if they're leaving the console or staying. Screenshot attached. Jonah: Oof. We should standardize: use 'Help' for in-app short surfaces, 'Docs' for the full site. Also the footer CTA should explicitly say 'Open full docs (new tab)'. Priya: Agreed. Small spec: header = 'Help', subhead = one-liner, footer CTA = 'Open full docs (new tab)' with external icon. Add ?source=help-panel to the URL for analytics. Example: /docs/console/quickstart?source=help-panel Marta: Accessibility notes: - close button has only SVG, add aria-label="Close help panel" - container should be role="dialog" aria-modal="true" - trigger needs aria-expanded and aria-controls - ensure focus returns to the trigger after close AccessibilityBot: Reminder: add an automated check that toggles the panel via keyboard and asserts document.activeElement === trigger on close. Elena: UX detail: show a tiny inline clarifier under header when terms diverge like 'Routes (called Endpoints in docs)'. Link text must be explicit: 'Read about Endpoints in full docs (opens in new tab)'. Jonah: For localization, let's include a context mapping in the i18n file so translators know when to use 'Help' vs 'Docs' vs product-specific nouns. I'll add entries to i18n/glossary.yml. Priya: Dev checklist for PR: - change header text - add clarifier paragraph under header when needed - footer CTA: Open full docs ↗ - add aria-labels and role attributes - emit analytics events: help_panel.view, help_panel.cta_click Marta: Tests I'll add: - a11y keyboard flow test (open via Enter/Space, tab to close, Escape closes, focus restored) - unit test verifying CTA href includes ?source=help-panel - visual contrast snapshot for dark mode CTA color Elena: Tiny copy tweak: use sentence case on CTA and keep it concise: 'Open full docs (new tab)'. Also tooltip on hover: 'Opens in a new tab'. Jonah: I'll wire a short redirect for legacy slugs on the docs side so old links still work: /docs/old-help-topic -> /docs/console/topic-slug?source=help-panel and add server-side canonical header. Priya: I'll update Figma with the new header, clarifier, and external icon. Tagging @design-review for quick signoff. Marta: Branch plan: feature/help-panel-terminology-map. I'll open a PR and tag accessibility and docs. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3567 Elena: Can we aim to land this in the next patch release? It's small but reduces a lot of support noise. Jonah: Yep — I'll coordinate redirects with docs deploy window. AccessibilityBot: Action items: add acceptance test, add ARIA labels, include screenreader string for CTA 'Open full docs, opens in new tab'. Priya: Thanks team — will update the i18n note and attach copy snippets. Will ping here when PR is up for review. Elena: Great, closing after PR merge and analytics verify help_panel.cta_click firing. Thanks!
